pages.text: By default water behaves as in vanilla: two sources make a third. For a harder game, set $(thing)water.sourceCreation$() to INFINITE$(o)BIOMES$()ONLY so that only oceans and rivers regenerate, and turn on $(thing)water.evaporation$() so small ponds dry up in hot weather.

Rain refills the land. During rain, water runs to the lowest point of each hollow. A closed hollow on slow-draining ground (clay, compacted soil, rock) fills block by block into a $(thing)pond$(). Flat, poorly drained ground collects $(thing)puddles$().
All of this is configurable: where sources may regenerate, how fast ponds form and evaporate, and how large a hollow may fill. Pumps and wells are planned for a later release.
